title: French Poached Dates with Chewy Ukrainian Twist
description: A unique French dessert featuring poached dates with a chewy Ukrainian twist, perfect for a sweet treat.
instructions: Preheat the water to 180°F for poaching.
Combine flour, sugar, eggs, and butter in a bowl to make the chewy dough.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Cut the dough into desired shapes.
Poach the dates in the preheated water for 10 minutes.
Add the vanilla extract to the poaching water.
Drain the poached dates and add to the chewy dough shapes.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F for 15 minutes.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
